- Data residency: For the pilot we can run inference in us-east-1; data handling is pseudonymized and logs can be restricted to customer-only access.
- PO format: We accept your standard PO for pilots and can sign a vendor addendum if needed; if legal needs a full MSA we can expedite review.

Champion enablement / talk tracks for Priya (one-slide bullets Rachel prepared):
- Why Redwood: predictable latency at scale and transparent cost levers — we estimate a 20% reduction in AHT and measurable cost per ticket improvement.
- Business impact: pilot metrics to watch: AHT, deflection rate, escalation % and accuracy delta vs baseline.
- Ask from execs: sign approval to run a 6-week pilot starting 8/24 contingent on security & procurement signoff.
- Suggested elevator: "This pilot gives us an empirical read on modern LLM inference without high upfront cost — if it meets the targets we can scale to 50% of tickets Q1."
